title: Bind leased worktree writes to authoritative task-state identity

owned: Permission-broker runtime configuration binding for authoritative task state
Exact isolated-worktree lease permission regression coverage
not_changing: Supervisor lease issuance or task generation semantics
Configured workspace roots or general Edit/Write allowlisting
TaskStore journal format and status command mutation behavior

acceptance.criterion: Validate the supervisor-issued canonical task-state identity before rebinding broker state
acceptance.evidence: load_broker_runtime_config requires authoritative mode, an absolute event journal, and an exact canonical identity before replacing mutable paths.

acceptance.criterion: Permit only an active exact-generation isolated-worktree lease
acceptance.evidence: Separate promoted child-process cases load the real V2 runtime cache and authoritative task journal: the exact lease is allowed, while stale canonical generation, sibling path, and parent path are denied. Existing expired-lease and mismatched-root coverage also remains green.

acceptance.criterion: Prove promoted-runtime behavior without broad allowlisting
acceptance.evidence: An independent Python process loads permission_broker from the command-code root, reads the worker lease from the rebound coordination-root state file, and reads task generation and ownership through task_state_store.load_snapshot(event_log). The ai-status.json projection is deliberately stale, so the exact-root allow result proves the authoritative journal loader supplied the decision state. No loader is monkeypatched in the child process.

results: 122 provider permission tests passed, including four promoted-runtime real-loader allow/deny cases
permission broker and test module compiled

required_checks: Confirm forged or incomplete canonical identity fails closed before path rebinding
Confirm the absolute authoritative event journal replaces the promoted runtime template path
Confirm the subprocess proof uses real runtime and journal files without monkeypatching either loader
Confirm stale generation, sibling path, and parent path each fail closed
